%@ var r shape=T,S domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Revised arrival time of train t at station s.

%@ var d shape=T,S domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Passenger delay incurred by train t at station s.

%@ con cancel_stop kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Stopping prohibited for cancelled trains.
%@ con cancel_shortturn kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Short‑turning prohibited for cancelled trains.
%@ con shortturn_one kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: At most one short‑turn point per train.
%@ con shortturn_stop kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Short‑turn implies stopping.
%@ con slot_assign kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Slot assignment links binary stop variable.
%@ con time_link kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Revised arrival time equals slot start time.
%@ con capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Platform capacity per station and slot.
%@ con delay_low kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Lower bound for delay variable.
%@ con delay_up kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Upper bound for delay variable.
%@ con delay_nonneg kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Non‑negativity of delay.

  \min\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T},\, s \in \mathcal{S}} \mathit{demand}_{t,s} \cdot d_{t,s}

  & \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} w_{t,s,p} = x_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{slot\_assign} \\

  & d_{t,s} \ge r_{t,s} - \mathit{a}_{t,s} - \mathit{M\_big} \cdot (1 - x_{t,s}) \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{delay\_low} \\

  & d_{t,s} \ge 0 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{delay\_nonneg}
\end{align}

  & d_{t,s} - r_{t,s} + \mathit{a}_{t,s} + \mathit{M\_big} \cdot x_{t,s} \le \mathit{M\_big} \qquad \forall t \in T,\; s \in S \tag{delay\_up} \\
  & d_{t,s} \ge 0 \qquad \forall t \in T,\; s \in S \tag{delay\_nonneg}
\end{align}
